app_info.subtitle: Save products to your wishlist
app_info.description: Wishfinity +W saves any product to your universal Wishfinity wishlist. Share a product page link and +W returns a link that saves it to wishfinity.com, where you can find it again, sort it into lists, and share it with friends and family.

justifications.read_only_justification: The tool only builds a wishfinity.com save link from the given product URL and returns it; it creates, updates and deletes nothing.
justifications.destructive_justification: Nothing the tool does is irreversible; it returns a link the user chooses to open, and makes no server-side change.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not access the internet or external systems when called; it returns a link to wishfinity.com that the user chooses to open.

test_cases.description: Save a specific Amazon product link for later.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a '+W Save to Wishfinity' link to wishfinity.com/add for that product, with no warning note.

test_cases.description: Add a specific Target product to the wishlist.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add this to my Wishfinity wishlist: https://www.target.com/p/some-product/-/A-12345678
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a '+W Save to Wishfinity' link for the product; the saved link preserves source=mcp-plusw.

test_cases.description: Save a product as a gift idea.
test_cases.user_prompt: Save this as a gift idea for my mom: https://www.etsy.com/listing/123456789/handmade-mug
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a '+W Save to Wishfinity' link for the Etsy listing.
Returns a '+W Save to Wishfinity' link for the product.

test_cases.description: Save a product whose URL carries its own query parameters.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a '+W Save to Wishfinity' link whose url parameter keeps the full product URL (including its &-separated query) percent-encoded.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Add a cordless vacuum to my wishlist
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The tool requires a product URL, so the assistant asks the user for the product link instead of calling the tool.

negative_test_cases.description: A search-results page, not a single product.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The tool returns the link but includes a note that this looks like a search results page, not a single product; the assistant relays the note and suggests a specific product link.

negative_test_cases.description: A request unrelated to saving a product.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What's the weather in Chicago today?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The tool is not relevant and is not called.
